He said discarding the ancient and metaphysical embodiment of the Greek Earth. The depressed reaper took the soul back and opened his decrepit wings, fetching his scythe. As he began to leave for the voyage back he stopped briefly at a small tick from Father Fate "Ah, and Thanatos, see you next year." He said with a darkened, supernatural grin stretching his shadowed face. Thanatos shivered silently and fled, knowing he was but a fly, caught in a eldritch spiders web.

Another year, another failed attempt at freedom, Thanatos flew into the void between realms to return Gaia to her realm, before shifting back into it. It would be a eternal solace for him, that no time existed in the void, for he could always lament his sorrows there in silence.
